scenario: LLOG.11.9: "a `logical` emit that follows such an emit in the same RHS" is refused too, "at the emit, naming the one that replaced the fact". `emit A logical id: a.id kind: "leave"` on line 11 replaces the `A` that `a` matched, so the match ends there, and `emit C logical id: a.id` on line 12 would be withdrawn as it is made. The vector pins line 12, the following emit, with `expected_line` (RCTS.1.2.34); line 11's own refusal is LLOG.11.9_self_replacing_emit's. `C` is `logical` with the flag on the emit, so LFAC.1.3.1 and LLOG.11.1 pass. Only a `logical` schema has an identity, so the replacing emit is always `logical` itself; a plain emit into a `ttl` `A` makes another fact and replaces nothing. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate`'s `llog_11_9_self_replacing_step`, over the rule's top-level actions.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    id: String key
    kind: String mutable

schema C scope logical:
    id: String key

rule flip:
    A a where a.kind == "enter"
->
    emit A logical id: a.id kind: "leave"
    emit C logical id: a.id
